title_zh: 年代剧：八十年代的记忆
title_en: Chinese TV Dramas (14/20): Period Dramas, Memories of the Eighties
note_en: 把……设定在…… ("set ... in ...") is a 把 sentence with a place phrase after the verb: 年代怀旧剧把故事的背景设定在二十世纪八十年代的中国 "nostalgia dramas set their stories in 1980s China." Where English just says "set the story in," Chinese puts the object after 把 and the destination after 在, a pattern also used with 放在, 写在, and 挂在.
